comparison: Trails unified-v11 (16/16), law4-muon-m (12/15), and sublinear-memory law4-adafactor-mp (11/15), while achieving the sharpest grid100 center_rms_sigma (0.0881) of any arm tested so far.
conclusion: Homogeneous peak_rms coordinate-wise Adam + MP + secant band (beta1=0.0, beta2=0.999, 2 states/param, 0 NS) achieves 9/15 graded PASS (6 numerical FAIL, 1 contention-TIMEOUT on five_word_joint_smoke) on r4-occam-ablation-v1. Delivers ultra-sharp grid100 accuracy (prec=0.9918, ctr=0.0881, mass_tv=0.0366), img_bars4 (4/4 hq=1.0), both >500x Nash tasks (hq=0.9810/0.9834), ring16 (0.9849), vector_unequal_mass/width, and both smokes, proving coordinate-wise adaptivity excels on shallow/Conv2d tasks; however, diagonal preconditioning cannot invert rank-1 spectral collapse on 16-layer skip-free grid100_mlp16 (prec=0.2551, mass_tv=0.6309) and fails model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (t1_q0_mean=0.4945), gaussian1d_stability, zero_tanh_rail_escape, t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (eig=0.4292), and t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (mass_tv=0.1328).
